name: The sword draws toward the Halls

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: From the frozen forge, Quel’Delar presses its bearer toward the Halls of Reflection. The quest frames this as compulsion: the blade has a will, and its direction leads into the Lich King’s chamber. This is a magical story beat, not a route inferred across a map. In the blue-black hall, the sword’s restoration turns inward. The first danger is no longer whether it can be wielded, but who commands whom.
